note: Adversarial by construction: every reader agrees on the real specs in docs/specs/ while a live divergence goes undetected, so a representative fixture proves nothing. Each expected value is REVIEWED against the spec Decisions (D6 reader-facing-wins, D7 reject-never-repair) and the enumerated deltas — never captured from whatever the readers happen to do. Edit these values by hand; a reader that disagrees is the finding.
